title: Malachi wore the collar of gold
html_source:
‘Let Erin Remember the Days of Old’ (1808), by the Irish Catholic songwiter Thomas Moore:

Let Erin remember the days of old
Ere her faithless sons betrayed her;
When Malachi wore the collar of gold
Which he won from the proud invader;
When her kings, with standard of green unfurled,
Led the Red Branch Knights to danger
Ere the emerald gem of the western world
Was set in the crown of a stranger.

Malachi was High King of Ireland at the end of the 10th century who fought for many years trying to expel the Norsemen from Dublin.
